item.title: Annual Point in Time survey measuring begins
item.description: This is an annual snapshot of the number of individuals in shelters, temporary housing, and unsheltered living situations.

item.title: East Helena schools searched following Helena High incident
item.description: On Thursday, each East Helena school was swept by law enforcement out of precaution following the discovery of a suspicious device around a block away from Helena High.

item.title: Investigation into data breach involving Blue Cross Blue Shield members could head to court
item.description: In October, MTN reported on a data breach involving customers with Blue Cross Blue Shield of Montana. Now, as a state investigation into the breach continues, the next steps could play out in court.
